messages.author: bff9e4feca8b059f
messages.subject: shiny and $.ajax() interference?
parts:
I have a shiny app that uses jQueryUI autocomplete text boxes that obtain their data via an AJAX call to a static .xml flat file, which gets served up by the shiny websocket (I could just dump this file into the index.html, but I like to keep things separate).  This is working fine when I have only two such text boxes, but with a third such ajax call any particular browser load causes one or more of the AJAX requests to fail.  it doesn't seem to be caused by timeout, and it's not consistent across browser reloads, i.e. it's some kind of race condition.  Any clues where I might look?  Is there interference between $.ajax() and Shiny?

-Aaron

messages.author: bff9e4feca8b059f
messages.subject: Re: shiny and $.ajax() interference?
parts:
In addition, making my $.ajax() calls use async: false clears up the problem ...

-Aaron
